purpose: Complete Tundra source gallery for selecting the production village catalog.
selectionRule: Every standalone CTOV Snowy Igloo template, every non-entity Dungeons & Taverns snowy tavern module, the complete CTOV snowy outpost building/detail set, and the Towns & Towers and Terralith snowy landmarks. Road pieces and entity-only jigsaw templates are omitted.
compatibilityPolicy: Snowy Igloo templates that reference absent compatibility mods remain visible as full architectural shells; their unavailable palette entries are replaced in the private display copy with neutral vanilla worksite markers.
sources: ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village 3.6.3: Snowy Igloo village and snowy outpost
Dungeons & Taverns 4.4.4: complete snowy tavern building and ground modules
Towns & Towers 1.13.9: Snowy Slopes inn and Snowy Plains outpost tower
Terralith 2.6.2: igloo and winter mage tower
